---
description: Run the marketplace feature gates selected by its risk level, changed files, and each gate's preconditions; close with evidence and knowledge capture.
---

Read the spec, risk level, changed files, and gate definitions. Select gates using the risk mapping and each gate's preconditions. First verify acceptance criteria and diagnostics. Next verify required tests, security and performance checks, and review findings. Then check migration/rollback needs, docs, and learning notes. Report passed checks, unresolved risks, and exact follow-ups. Never claim completion without evidence.
